name: get_current_question
description: Read the currently displayed, eligible WASL question. Ask only its wording and keep its question_ref for the next proposal.

name: propose_patient_answer
description: Propose the meaning of the last actual spoken patient answer after asking the current WASL question. Do not call for silence or a confirmation. The app validates the transcript and the patient confirms on screen.

name: get_answer_status
description: Read whether WASL persisted the current proposal. Check once after the patient indicates they used the on-screen confirmation. Only report success when the returned status is recorded.
